overloads.semanticRole: Returns an object describing the current cache contents (used memory, and the tables/indexes/BLOBs etc. currently loaded), optionally scoped to all running databases instead of just the current one.

constraints: Only works in local mode (4D and 4D Server); must not be called from a 4D application running in remote mode.

dbFilter is an object carrying a "dbFilter" attribute: pass the value "All" to get cache information for every running database (including components), or "" (or omit the parameter) to restrict to the current database only.
